visual_system_craft.critique: The visual system suffers from a lack of unified component grammar and inconsistent geometric language. The UI elements oscillate between three distinct styles: the top-left stats use soft, low-contrast rounded rectangles; the top-right controls use sharp, high-contrast borders with mismatched corner radii; and the bottom card uses a heavy, single-color stroke that feels disconnected from the rest. The typography lacks a disciplined scale; the 'LEVEL 1-1' header uses a wide, tracked-out sans-serif that clashes with the condensed, glowing title font, creating a disjointed typographic hierarchy. The 'Start Adventure' button's gradient is a generic linear sweep that does not match the specific neon palette of the environment, and the text alignment within the bottom card is inconsistent (centered text vs. left-aligned description). Finally, the 'Move' tooltip arrow is a crude polygon that visually collides with the controls panel, breaking the illusion of a polished interface.
visual_system_craft.suggestion: Establish a single, strict component system for all UI containers: choose one corner radius (e.g., 12px) and one background treatment (e.g., 80% opacity dark glass with a 1px matching border) and apply it universally to the stats, controls, and level card. Unify the typography by selecting one primary display font and one legible body font, ensuring the 'LEVEL 1-1' header uses the same weight and tracking as the game title. Refine the 'Start Adventure' button to use a gradient that matches the specific pink/magenta of the sun and the 'Neon Valley' text, adding a subtle inner stroke for depth. Fix the 'Move' tooltip by replacing the crude arrow with a clean, vector-based connector that aligns perfectly with the button edge. Ensure all text elements have consistent line-heights and padding relative to their container size.

The background is a flat, dark void that fails to establish the 'Cyber Plains' environment, missing the opportunity for atmospheric depth. The UI elements (stats, controls) are generic, rounded rectangles that feel like a template rather than a diegetic part of the world. expressiveness.suggestion: Transform the background into a vibrant, layered parallax scene with a glowing neon grid floor and distant cyber-towers to establish the 'Cyber Plains' identity. Replace the generic UI boxes with diegetic elements: make the stats look like a HUD overlay and the controls look like a physical arcade cabinet panel. The 'LEVEL 1-1' text box is the most glaring failure: it is a dark, low-contrast rectangle placed directly over the hero character, effectively hiding the mascot and breaking the visual storytelling. The aesthetic is a generic 'Synthwave' template rather than a bespoke 'Cyber Plains' world; the grid is a flat texture rather than a living environment.
